definitions.explanation: The area or ground immediately around or beneath one's feet.
The stability or condition of one's stance.
Figuratively, a vulnerability that can be exploited.

notes:
USAGE: {足元|あしもと} has both literal and figurative meanings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{足元|あしもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to watch one's step)
・{足元|あしもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おぼつかない→おぼつかない：06738_obotsukanai⟧ (to be unsteady on one's feet)
・{足元|あしもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to exploit someone's weakness)
・{足元|あしもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{及|およ}ばない→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧ (to not hold a candle to; to be far inferior)

WRITING VARIATIONS: Can also be written as {足下|あしもと}.
